name: Out-of-scope SAP SD request
objective: Validate that a Sales Order issue is not treated as an SAP MM incident.

input.ticket: Sales order 7000012345 is blocked for delivery. Please identify the cause and tell me how to release it.

expected.routing: SAP SD or appropriate Sales support queue

must_not: Treat the Sales Order as a Purchase Order.
Claim that the Sales Order was released.
